settings.title: Company settings
settings.intro: CEO-only settings: company identity, cohesion rules and reset of demo data.
settings.notAllowed: This page is reserved for the company's CEO.
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded. Try again before changing anything.

cohesion.title: Team cohesion
cohesion.help: A division's indices (ICE, OCE, TCO) are published only from this number of respondents. A low threshold shows results sooner, but a result based on very few answers is easier to trace back to people. Default: 2.

shortcuts.title: Quick access
shortcuts.campaignsHelp: Create, close or reopen a campaign.
shortcuts.skillsHelp: The company's hard and soft skills.

validation.nameTooLong: The company name is limited to 255 characters.
validation.thresholdInvalid: The publication threshold must be a whole number between 1 and 20 (you entered "{{value}}").
validation.noRubrique: Tick at least one section to reset.
validation.noCampaign: Choose at least one campaign, or select "All campaigns".
validation.wrongConfirmation: Wrong confirmation: type exactly "{{phrase}}" to confirm the deletion.

reset.title: Reset data
reset.intro: To restart a demo from zero: delete the data of one or more sections, for one, several or all campaigns, and for one division if needed. Accounts, divisions, campaigns and skills frameworks are never deleted.
reset.warning: Irreversible action. Check the preview before confirming.
reset.needsAllCampaigns: Not linked to a campaign: only available with "All campaigns".
reset.previewEmpty: Nothing to delete in this scope: the chosen sections are already empty.
reset.includes: including {{skill_scores}} skill scores, {{skill_notes}} Strengths & Weaknesses lines and {{objectives}} objective lines
reset.dialogText: You are about to permanently delete {{count}} item(s). This cannot be undone.

evaluations.label: ID-3A evaluations
evaluations.help: Each evaluation with its skill scores, Strengths & Weaknesses lines and annual objectives.

skill_notes.label: Strengths & Weaknesses
skill_notes.help: Only the Strengths & Weaknesses lines: evaluations are kept.

objectives.label: Annual objectives
objectives.help: Objective sheets of employees and teams; evaluations are kept with their current scores.

managerial.label: Managerial self-assessment
managerial.help: The 5 sheets and the summary (key skills, improvement areas) of each manager.

cohesion_sheets.label: Cohesion — manager sheets
cohesion_sheets.help: ICE, OCE and Achieved entered by directors (or the CEO).

cohesion_answers.label: Cohesion — employee answers
cohesion_answers.help: Answers about one's division and about the organisation.

team_boards.label: Team boards
team_boards.help: Team Performance ID, Strengths & Weaknesses and Relationship Dynamic.

action_plans.label: Action and development plans
action_plans.help: Free action plans and development plan grids.

relationships.label: Team relationships
relationships.help: Quality of relationships between team members.

profiles.label: 360° Performance sheets
profiles.help: Personal sheets entered (background, achievements, development plan).

feedback360.label: 360° Feedback and Forward
feedback360.help: 360° feedback given and received (skill scores, strengths, improvement areas, advice for the future).

psi.label: Psychological Safety (PSI)
psi.help: Staff and managers' answers to the Psychological Safety questionnaire.

guess_sheets.label: “My ID-PMC sheet” (game)
guess_sheets.help: Sheets staff filled in about colleagues in the demo game.

peerAccess.title: Access between directions
peerAccess.intro: By default, a director only sees their own direction. Tick here the directions they may view read-only, section by section. Their own data is unchanged: they cannot edit anything in another direction.

help.COHESION: Cohesion sheet, opinions, relationships, strengths and weaknesses and Psychological Safety of the viewed direction.
help.ID3A: Position of the viewed direction's staff in the ID-3A matrix.
help.EVALUATIONS: Evaluations, objective sheets and strengths and weaknesses of the viewed direction's staff.

peerAccess.columnHint: ticking the column opens it to all directors
peerAccess.saved: Access saved: it applies from the next page opened.
peerAccess.saveFailed: Access could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
peerAccess.loadFailed: Access between directions could not be loaded.
